subject: glacier ice worm
title: This Worm Lives Inside Glaciers and Melts If It Gets Too Warm

scenes.text: A worm lives its whole life inside a glacier. Hold it in your hand and it dies.
The glacier ice worm is about an inch long, black, and it lives in glaciers in Alaska and the Pacific Northwest.
It's happiest right around zero degrees Celsius, the temperature of melting ice.
Warm it past about five degrees, and its cells start to break down until the body turns to liquid.
At dusk, thousands rise to the surface to feed on algae, then sink back down before the sun returns.
Its whole world is a glacier, and the glaciers are shrinking.
